subject: Top-down PO carveout matrix for freelance trials
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellis Grant <ellis@fluxops.io>
Date: 2026-12-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Top-down PO carveout matrix for freelance trials

Hi team and Ellis,

We have a small pilot with FluxOps (deal FLX-TRIAL-312) that will bring on ~6 freelance contractors over a 30-day trial window. Procurement is asking whether we can accept a temporary "no-PO" lane for freelancer costs under specific controls (evidence-lite intake + capped spend). Ellis, they need this to move quickly on your side.

Proposal (high level):
- Trial cap: $3,000 total, $1,000 per contractor max.
- Evidence-lite intake: ID, contract stub (one-pager), deliverable summary (2–3 bullets).
- Approval ladder: CS owner -> Revenue ops manager -> Procurement exception (one-time).
- Duration: up to 30 days; finance to invoice and reconcile afterward.

I've attached a short evidence checklist and a blank procurement matrix I used last quarter. Can we agree on thresholds and the minimal approver chain so procurement can log an exception? If internal sign-off is OK, I'll route to procurement for a formal carveout.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-lite-checklist.pdf (1 page - checklist), procure-matrix.xlsx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Ellis Grant <ellis@fluxops.io>
Date: 2026-12-13T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Top-down PO carveout matrix for freelance trials

Neha — thanks for framing this. I like the evidence-lite approach for short trials. A couple of thoughts/questions: 

1) Thresholds: can we lower the total cap to $2,500 for the initial pilot (safety buffer) and keep $1,000 per contractor as a hard per-person cap?
2) Approver ladder: CS owner -> Marissa (CS lead) -> Finance Manager (not generic revenue ops) -> Procurement SME (David) -> Procurement exception logged. That gives finance visibility before procurement sign-off.
3) Evidence: add a quick compliance checkbox: no access to customer production data; workers on sandbox only.

If everyone is good, I'll draft the short exception memo (one page) and attach it to the procurement ticket. Ellis — can your legal or ops teams produce the one-pager contract stub and a short deliverable list today? That would let us closed-loop within 24–36 hours.

Agree with Marissa on lowering the initial cap to $2,500. From procurement perspective we need two additions before I can log an exception:

- A single procurement ticket with the exception memo (Marissa to draft).
- Scan of the evidence-lite checklist filled by FluxOps + vendor onboarding short form (name, tax ID, payment remit).

I'll add the carveout into our procurement matrix under a temporary lane (30-day TTL) and mark it as "one-off pilot". Attached is the matrix I referenced — it includes approval thresholds and who signs in Workday/ERP. Once the ticket and checklist are attached, I can approve the procurement exception and add FluxOps to the temporary allowlist.

David
David Kim
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: procure-matrix.xlsx

Thanks all — quick recap and action plan: 

Decision:
- Pilot cap set to $2,500 total; $1,000 per contractor hard cap.
- Evidence-lite intake required (ID + contract stub + 2–3 bullet deliverables + sandbox-access confirmation).
- Approver ladder: CS owner (FluxOps contact) -> Marissa (CS lead) -> Finance Manager -> David (Procurement) approves exception.
- Duration: 30 days; Procurement will add FluxOps to a temporary allowlist and Finance will reconcile post-trial.

Action items:
- Marissa: draft the one-page exception memo and attach to procurement ticket (ETA: EOD 12/13).
- Ellis / FluxOps: upload contract stub + deliverable list to the Drive link and complete the evidence checklist (link below) (ETA: 12/14 morning).
- David: once ticket and checklist are attached, add FluxOps to temporary allowlist and set TTL.
- Neha: create HubSpot event and note under DEAL FLX-TRIAL-312.

Links & attachments:
- Evidence checklist (attached): evidence-lite-checklist.pdf
- Procurement matrix (attached): procure-matrix.xlsx
- Working doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cProcureMatrix
- HubSpot: 780-FLX-312

I'll open the procurement ticket once Marissa drops the memo. If anything changes, flag it in the ticket thread.

Best,
Neha
